# Project continuity

Before working on this project, read `PROJECT.md`, `DECISIONS.md`,
`CHAT_LOG.md`, and `TODO.md`.

Treat these files as saved context, not as a complete chat archive. Distinguish
confirmed facts from unknown information. Never invent missing conversations,
farm requirements, or decisions.

When project discussions produce confirmed requirements, agreed decisions, or
changed next steps, update the relevant notes as part of the requested work.
Keep discussion summaries concise and factual. Only claim that notes were
saved to GitHub after the remote update succeeds.

This repository is public. Do not record secrets, personal information, private
conversation transcripts, or confidential project details.
